Validation performed in the build container for version 1.2.0:

  gcc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -O2 -Iinclude

Results:

  - C89 preview renderer compiled with no warnings
  - static archive generated
  - `nm -u` reported no undefined symbols in the core object
  - 12 individual physical PCM WAV previews plus one physical catalog generated

  - preview format: mono, 44100 Hz, signed 16-bit PCM
  - context size on the validation host: 6304 bytes
  - core object size on the validation host: 10904 bytes
  - static archive size on the validation host: 11318 bytes
  - source token scan after stripping comments and string literals found no use of:
    malloc, calloc, realloc, free, float or double
    in `src/gweaponfoley89.c` or `include/gweaponfoley89.h`
  - core includes none of math.h, stdlib.h or stdio.h
  - maximum measured absolute peak in physical previews: 0.944 FS
  - spectral-centroid change versus 1.1: -0.43 kHz to -3.08 kHz

Sizes vary by compiler, ABI and archive format.
